final: WITH j AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member me JOIN major m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j), s AS (SELECT j.major_id, j.department, j.cnt, CAST(j.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM j, t), d AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg FROM s) SELECT major_id, department, cnt AS member_count, share, share - dept_avg AS diff_above_avg FROM d WHERE share > dept_avg ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
